page_note: Page is dominated by sapiential-correspondential teaching: wisdom likened to a child in the womb (and to fire hidden in wood). The mapping stays internal — natural processes (gestation, birth, fire-in-wood) correlate with the unfolding of wisdom in the heart of the man. No institutional vocabulary, no Mani-attribution, no polemic. The 'comparison' (ⲡⲓⲧⲁⲛⲧⲛ̄) idiom and the systematic 'According to this manner / Thus then is this manner' framing are characteristic of the correspondential substrate. Damage is heavy (81.6%) but does not obscure layer identification. Segment 32 contains the formulaic ⲧⲧⲁⲗⲓⲛ ('once again') bridge introducing the next analogy — flagged as mixed since the bridge is a redactional connector while the substantive predication is teaching.
